title: Server version 1.344
items: Changes: Hunting Sites of your tier are now more likely to be found
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) Fixed an issue spawning the Tier 3 Utgard Hunting Site

title: Server version 1.343
items: Changes: (Orna) Fixed an issue where using each Waxlight would reset Hunting Site locations
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) Fixed an issue where stacking Waxlights resulted in more Hunting Sites than expected
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) Fixed an issue where Hunting Sites at lesser tiers were not spawning

title: Server version 1.342
items: Changes: Due to popular demand, the Titan Crucible has been returned to Titan Mnemosyne's drop pool
Changes: Reduced the cost of the Titan Crucible in the Event Hub crafting section

title: Server version 1.341
items: Changes: The Giants & Titans monsters can now be found in the world too
Changes: Hunting Site visibility is no longer bound to player view distance
Changes: Decreased the rarity of the Celestial Moondrop
Changes: Added a Tower Shard bonus to each of Hyperion's weapons
Changes: Added an additional Hunting Sites bonus to each of the Waxlights
Changes: Improved the tiering of Hunting Sites, improving the number of Hunting Sites available to lower tiers
Changes: Added the Titan Crucible to the Event Hub crafting section

title: App update v3.27.4
items: New features: Added the quick equipment menu to the Hunting Site screen
New features: Updated November assets

title: App update v3.27.3
items: New features: New Guild: The King's Guard
New features: "Gleaming" monsters can now be found out in the world, providing additional rewards from the King's Guard guild
Changes: Replaced the "Riftbreaks" feature with a new "Hunting Sites" feature. Deepen your allegiance to the King's Guard by finding daily Hunting Sites throughout the world
Changes: Haunted Houses have been moved to the Dungeon map layer
Changes: Bug fixes and translations updates

title: Server version 1.340
items: Changes: (Orna) Increased the amount of Hunting Sites found in the world
Changes: Hunting Sites will no longer produce hordes for low tier players
Changes: Increased the proof cost of the Writ of the Royal Hunt
Changes: Removed materials from the King's Guard guild shop
Changes: Lowered the Ornate chest proof cost for lower tier players
Changes: Remove the Valhallen/Elysian chest type as there is not enough gear in that category to properly support it
Changes: Ornate chests now have a weekly limit, based on player tier
Changes: "1 Level" chests now have a weekly limit, based on player tier
Changes: Added Summoning Scrolls and Skeleton Keys to the King's Guard guild shop
Changes: Misc King's Guard bug fixes

title: Server version 1.339
items: Changes: Bladeless: Increased Chained Chance from 20% to 30%
Changes: The Aglostrike skells now do mixed Arcane/Physical element damage
Changes: Arisen Pumpkinless follower Bestial Bond 1: Increased Chained Chance from 20% to 40%
Changes: Arisen Pumpkinless follower Bestial Bond 2: Replaced Chained Damage chance with Two-Handed power

title: Server version 1.338
items: Changes: Event Allegiance XP per level now caps at level 100, meaning every level after 100 does not require additional XP
Changes: Damage limits in Blades of Finesse are now enforced per actor (and their follower/summons), rather than per target. This will allow focus fire in team PvP

title: Server version 1.337
items: New features: Haunted Houses now show a '!' on the map when they are off cooldown
Changes: Bladeless: added 20% Chain Damage Chance
Changes: Arisen Pumpkinless follower: replaced Aglostrike II with Aglostrike III
Changes: Arisen Pumpkinless follower: Bestial Bond Level 2 Chain Damage Chance increased from 10% to 20%
Changes: Arisen Pumpkinless follower: Bestial Bond Level 3 now adds 20% Bonded Magic
Changes: Event levels: every level from event level 100 onward now costs the same amount of experience

title: Server version 1.336
items: Changes: Beheaded Charmer's Lute: Disperse Status Chance -> Ally Effect Chance
Changes: Increased the amount of Haunted Houses in the world
Changes: Improved the rewards of trick or treating loot bag opening

title: Server version 1.335
items: Changes: Updated Crimson Festival
Changes: Medusa follower: updated AoE focused Bestial Bond
Changes: Medusa follower: Replaced Arrowstorm with Arrowstorm II
Changes: Medusa follower: Removed Full Bend II, Magic Arrow IV, Magic Chakram, added Stonefire
Changes: "Gear Up" Community Contest winners added to this game: Unspeakable Tentacle, Bloodied Staff, Tower Door Shield, Sarbacane

title: App update v3.26.4
items: Changes: Support for an updated Hallowed event
Changes: Improved the display of locked items
Changes: Improved the display when multiple Crucibles could be used on an item
Changes: Follower lists are now paginated
Changes: Misc bug fixes & updated translations
Notable bug fixes: Fixed a battle freeze issue when collateral damage defeats a summon
Notable bug fixes: Fixed an issue where popup rewards were invisible after switched characters

title: Server version 1.334
items: Changes: Revamped website
Changes: The Darkrift Crucible is now an additional guaranteed drop when completing the Darkrift Dungeon
Changes: Added 5% Ward Power bonus to each piece of the Judge Trifecta warrior gear
Changes: Increased dexterity of each piece of the Judge Trifecta thief gear
Changes: Added 7% Avidity bonus to the Judge Trifecta Falx
Changes: Shade of Achlys, the Red Dagger Summon: removed Drain II, added Osmostrike III
Changes: Fixed an issue with the Zeta Riftlock not affecting raid rewards correctly

title: Server version 1.333
items: Changes: Support for an updated September event
Changes: Bug fixes and translation updates

title: App update v3.26.2
items: Changes: Updated Riftfall assets
Changes: Updated Dragon Roost sprite
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) Improved the potency of the interation range bonus
Changes: Standardized event type headings: Main Event, Guest Event, Mini Event, Booster Event, and Special Event
Changes: Translation updates
Notable bug fixes: Fixed an issue where summons could become invisible after when Charon Ritual procs on the same turn as other summons being defeated
Notable bug fixes: Fullscreen popups now appear one at a time instead of stacking on top of each other when you enter the game
Notable bug fixes: Other misc bug fixes

title: Server version 1.332
items: Changes: Peluda and Velue can now be found in Towers of Olympia
Changes: Wyrmquill Ballista: increased Attack, decreased Magic, Added Dmg ↑, added +10% Dragon Damage
Changes: Poison Quillstorm: decreased mana cost to 80
Changes: Yelmogus Greatsword: Removed Frenzy Bonus, added Crit Damage Bonus and Multi-target Damage Conus

title: Server version 1.331
items: Changes: Support for the reworked Spelunking Guild
Changes: Exploration dungeons are now disabled. Goblin Fortresses and Mystic caves are now back to being Battle Dungeons
Changes: Medea is now back to being found in Mystic Caves only
Changes: Support for an updated Wyrmhunt event
Changes: Added the Guild Proof bonus to the Proof of Undying Allegiance item
Changes: Capped the amount of materials earned from Memory Hunts when multiple Memory Hunt bonuses Events are stacked
Changes: Exploration Dungeon quests in Archpaths have been converted to normal Battle Dungeons
Changes: Increased the materials gained when completing World Raids
Changes: Increased the materials gained when completing Dungeons
Changes: Increased the materials gained when completing floors in Towers of Olympia
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) The view distance stat has been reworked as "Interation Distance"

title: App update v3.26.1
items: New features: Added a "Current events only" filter to forfeiting in the Monumental Guild
Changes: Spelunking Guild rework: The Spelunking Guild is now Battle Dungeon focused, providing a number of ways to enhance your Battle Dungeon experience
Changes: Explorations Dungeons have been disabled
Changes: Items can now be unnamed by leaving the rename field blank
Changes: (Hero of Aethric) The view distance stat has been reworked as "Interation Distance"
Changes: Reorganized the player profile screen
Changes: Reduced the length of the Tap-the-Wisp Memory Hunt minigame
